scope: 55 supplied English cards for existing notes; resolved through the approved path map. Existing detailed text and PNG pixels are preserved.
review_method: Opened every supplied image at full resolution in a two-card inspection sheet. Read original-paper method, result-table attribution and limitations; cross-checked numeric tokens against the same-revision PDF. Token presence supplements manual dataset/protocol attribution rather than verifying it automatically.

papers.method_review: Replace one quarter of global-attention layers with cross-frame register attention; updated registers return context through frame attention. One dense multi-task head uses low-resolution DPT plus MLP/pixel shuffle. Filtered geometry data and an EMA teacher/student protocol support dynamic and unlabeled videos.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Section 3.1 and 4.2: combined changes use about 30% of VGGT training memory, equivalent to about 70% savings. Inference memory is similar after correcting unnecessary intermediate caching in VGGT. Camera/depth gains span static and dynamic benchmarks.
papers.qualifications_review: Training-memory savings are not inference-memory savings. Strong blur, abrupt field-of-view changes, lens distortion and training-data artifacts remain difficult.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Calibrated RGB-D plus robot proprioception lift CLIP semantic features into the hand frame. Workspace/behind-hand cropping and feature-distance sampling reduce points; language-conditioned attention pooling produces a vector for jointly trained ACT, Diffusion Policy or BAKU imitation learning.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Figure 7, six real tasks: average completion 85.0% at the original viewpoint and 79.4% at an unseen viewpoint. These measure task progress, not binary success; cross-embodiment tests are simulated.
papers.qualifications_review: Requires depth, camera calibration and end-effector pose. Reflective/translucent sensing failures, bimanual use and robots with different action spaces remain limitations.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Image and optional calibrated geometry encoders fuse tokens through alternating attention. Dense rays and relative depths, camera rotation/relative translation, and a separate global scale head form a differentiable metric point-cloud pipeline. Random input combinations and standardized mixed-data supervision train one model.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2 image-only two-view benchmark, averaged across ETH3D, ScanNet++ v2 and TartanAirV2: mean point relative error 0.08 versus VGGT 0.20. Other input modalities are separate conditions.
papers.qualifications_review: No explicit input uncertainty model. Pixel-aligned output limits large-scene scaling; dynamic motion is not modeled and predicted metric scale can fail.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Freeze Gen3R/Wan and train a SceneAnchor branch conditioned only on source RGB plus evolving denoising state. Only one edited RGB latent is observed; other RGB and all geometry latents are jointly generated. Edit/background masks balance training losses but are not inference inputs.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Appendix B.9 Table 10: 49-frame full-3D inference takes 11.94 s on one H200 with five denoising steps. Synthetic SceneEdit3D-15K training and real 360-USID evaluation are distinct; background gains are mixed.
papers.qualifications_review: Reference mistakes can propagate. Native geometry follows the source trajectory; arbitrary novel-view rendering requires a downstream representation rather than native 3DGS output.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Find a compatible cut in a pretrained 3D model by fitting a linear map from ordered-view video-VAE latents. Refine the stitched decoder with original-model pseudo targets, then reward-fine-tune the video denoiser for prompt/image quality, rendered 3D quality and multiview consistency.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables 1-2: favorable rendered-view scores on T3Bench, SceneBench and DPG-Bench across tested pairings. Text-to-pointmap examples are qualitative; these are generated-content scores rather than measured real-scene geometry.
papers.qualifications_review: Video encoder expects smoothly ordered views. Arbitrarily unordered inputs are not guaranteed, and inference denoising remains iterative.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: VGGT-initialized context features and target-timestamp-conditioned Gaussian queries interact through bidirectional self-attention. A fixed compact query set decodes target-time Gaussians; an optional separately trained video-diffusion stage refines renderings. Depth/normal/tracking pseudo-supervision supports training.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, feed-forward TUM-Dynamics NVS: 2K Gaussians and PSNR 19.52 dB without supplied ground-truth poses. Refinement is an additional iterative stage, not part of a single feed-forward pass.
papers.qualifications_review: Unseen regions leave holes; diffusion may hallucinate plausible content rather than recover truth. Temporal interpolation does not reliably extrapolate future frames.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: DUSt3R pairwise geometry/features and frozen MoGe monocular priors are confidence-aligned with an Umeyama similarity fit. A trained ConvGRU repeatedly predicts residual point-map offsets; only the last two DUSt3R decoder blocks/head and refinement module are trained.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, 7Scenes with ten views at 224 by 224: pose mAA@30 is 0.728 versus DUSt3R 0.576. Table 3 ETH3D mAA is slightly worse than DUSt3R, so gains are not uniform.
papers.qualifications_review: Low-resolution evaluation and frozen monocular errors limit the claim. Default two-step refinement adds inference computation.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: MASt3R supplies two-view point maps, matches and confidence. Robust ray-space tracking estimates Sim(3) relative pose and fuses explicit keyframe point maps. Retrieval, relocalization and sparse second-order graph optimization align keyframe poses; known calibration switches to calibrated rays/pixel residuals.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Abstract and runtime appendix: about 15 FPS overall on RTX 4090 at a 512-pixel long side. TUM, 7Scenes, ETH3D and EuRoC comparisons separate calibrated and uncalibrated conditions.
papers.qualifications_review: Single central camera assumption remains; pinhole-trained predictions degrade with distortion. Full-resolution decoding dominates latency, and backend optimization does not refine every geometry pixel.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Four-frame windows with stride two jointly attend to image/state tokens. A convolutional head predicts camera-local points; local/global camera tokens enter a compact historical pool for pose prediction. Overlap keeps updated poses and higher-confidence point maps.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 4 KITTI depth uses per-sequence scale alignment: Abs Rel 0.081 versus CUT3R 0.122; 17.2 FPS on one A800.
papers.qualifications_review: Waits for a full window; the camera-token pool grows with sequence length. Dynamic-scene depth gains are mixed and aligned depth is not an absolute-scale guarantee.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: VGGT-derived alternating attention embeds supplied intrinsics and a selected query time. Geometry heads reconstruct in first-frame coordinates; a motion head directly maps observed 3D points to the query frame. Geometry training precedes query/motion training with synthetic trajectory labels.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2 PointOdyssey tracking, 64-frame sequences with tracks starting in frame one and global median scaling: APD 91.33% versus St4RTrack 67.95%.
papers.qualifications_review: No explicit causal or temporal-continuity model; not continuous arbitrary-time trajectories. Synthetic tracking supervision and median-scaled evaluation do not establish absolute-scale accuracy.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Encode normalized intrinsics and relative poses as camera tokens through zero-initialized residual adapters; encode normalized depth and validity as patch tokens added directly without a zero-convolution. Random modality subsets train camera, depth and point-map heads.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, unseen Sintel ten-image RGB-only depth: AbsRel 0.722 for VGGT versus 0.558 for OmniVGGT. Supplied depth/camera results are separate conditions; Table 6 robotics is simulated CALVIN.
papers.qualifications_review: Auxiliary gains depend on available priors. RGB-only geometry is not uniformly better across benchmarks, and CALVIN does not establish real-robot transfer.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Mix a pretrained TRELLIS sparse-structure flow transformer with Pi3 image/point-map tokens and an alignment-transform token. Jointly generate coarse voxels, point maps and aligned cameras; overlap-derived patch-to-voxel attention bias guides a pretrained textured-geometry stage without extra stage-two training.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables 1-3 report alignment, novel-view/geometry and camera results on rendered Toys4K and GSO. Real phone-image examples are qualitative; camera refinement is an additional optimization step.
papers.qualifications_review: View distribution, nonuniform lighting and specularity can degrade alignment. Frozen TRELLIS decoders limit faithful text and logo reconstruction.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Run original VGGT for initial depth/confidence and attention-derived motion masks. Suppress dynamic keys in early layers of a second pass to stabilize cameras. Preserve first-pass dynamic depth and confidence-blend static depths, then lift using stabilized cameras.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, DyCheck: mean point-cloud Distance 0.0646 for VGGT4D versus 0.0516 for the method. The table does not explicitly give units; relative translation and rotation errors worsen.
papers.qualifications_review: Two forward passes and motion-mask/confidence errors remain. Better point-cloud metrics do not imply every pose metric improves.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Fuse RGB with synchronized event features using Retinex enhancement, a lightweight event Swin adapter and SNR-guided cross-modal attention. Add event-derived brightness-consistency constraints to MonST3R-style global alignment, camera smoothing and flow objectives.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, real MVSEC outdoor_night3 monocular depth: AbsRel 0.317 for MonST3R versus 0.288 for EAG3R. EAG3R receives additional event data; Table 3 separates component contributions.
papers.qualifications_review: Requires high-quality synchronized events; sparse, noisy or misaligned events can hurt. Suitable real RGB/event geometry datasets are limited and global optimization adds cost.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Encode ERP panorama patches with spherical sine/cosine position embeddings, alternate intra-panorama and global attention, and use branch-specific spherical adapters for poses and local/global points. Joint SO(3) RGB/depth/pose augmentation and randomized anchors support unordered inputs.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2, Matterport3D three-view pose evaluation: AUC@30 is 0.305 for panorama-retrained Pi3* versus 0.459 for PanoVGGT. AUC is not a binary success rate. PanoCity is synthetic outdoor training data.
papers.qualifications_review: Designed for ERP panoramas; indoor/outdoor and synthetic-to-real domain shifts remain. Pose and depth gains are benchmark-dependent.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Use shared multi-view decoding with per-layer cached tokens and terminal-to-early-layer 3D feedback. Predict local and shared-frame point maps, derive poses by Procrustes, and retain spatially novel keyframes. A second rendering pass can revisit frames with future memory.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, eleven TUM RGB sequences: causal MUSt3R-C mean ATE RMSE 7.1 cm at 11.1 FPS versus second-pass MUSt3R 5.5 cm at 8.4 FPS on a V100. Rendering means recomputing geometry, not RGB novel-view synthesis.
papers.qualifications_review: Selected-keyframe memory still grows. Views far from the first frame are difficult; this VO pipeline is not a full loop-closing SLAM system.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Combine short-term optical flow and long-term DynPT tracks/mobility. Static tracks estimate fundamental matrices; epipolar residuals produce motion masks. Optimize depth, intrinsics and poses with camera-motion alignment, trajectory smoothness and track-guided dense point smoothing.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Experiments compare point-map backbones on synthetic Sintel and real dynamic video; camera, depth and tracking gains vary by backbone and metric. Aligned-depth results do not establish absolute metric scale.
papers.qualifications_review: Test-time optimization adds cost. Tracking, flow and motion-mask errors can propagate into camera and dense geometry estimates.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Use source geometry latents and target camera latents in a learned modulation/DPT flow head. Add covisibility-masked flow pseudo-label supervision from unlabeled videos to labeled camera/3D training; the factored branch avoids explicit depth-to-camera projection.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 compares flow formulations under controlled data. Table 4 scales SpatialVID unlabeled videos alongside labeled OmniWorld; flow supervision improves geometry/camera estimates but does not eliminate all 3D supervision.
papers.qualifications_review: Off-the-shelf flow errors transfer. Multiple independently moving objects remain hard; much larger training scales are proposed rather than demonstrated.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Condition a DUSt3R pair model with patchified intrinsic rays, normalized depth plus validity, and a normalized relative-pose CLS token. Three point-map heads support single-pass Procrustes pose recovery; multiview outputs use pairwise global alignment. Crop-and-stitch processing handles high resolution.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 4, DTU MVS Overall in mm: reproduced DUSt3R 1.894, RGB-only Pow3R 1.743, and Pow3R with intrinsics plus relative poses 1.115. Original DUSt3R paper results differ from this reproduced baseline.
papers.qualifications_review: Outputs remain up to scale. Priors have different effects; pose-only input does not uniformly help. Naively feeding high resolution degrades performance.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Lift one image using MoGe depth, forward-splat Cosmos latents along target cameras, and predict residual latent corrections using masks, rays and reference context. A frozen LYRA decoder produces 3D Gaussians. Train first through decoder cross-view feature distillation, then rendered perceptual losses on synthetic scenes.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Section 4.6: 36.2 seconds per scene on A6000, including 35.04 seconds in the frozen 3DGS decoder. Table 1 shows benchmark-dependent tradeoffs against LYRA; no iterative diffusion sampling is needed at inference.
papers.qualifications_review: Low warp coverage and fine detail remain difficult. Unobserved content is inferred, and synthetic distillation targets are not captured real-view ground truth.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Encode the full RGB video once with alternating frame/global attention. Independent cross-attention queries specify source pixel/time, target time, camera-reference time and a local RGB patch; each predicts a 3D point. Different query sets produce tracks, depth, clouds and camera correspondences.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 3, single A100: maximum full-video tracks at a 60-FPS throughput target are 550 for D4RT versus 29 for SpatialTrackerV2. Throughput varies with query count and does not remove full-video encoding cost.
papers.qualifications_review: Full-video representation is computed first. Initial camera recovery assumes a centered pinhole model unless nonlinear refinement is added.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Freeze Human3R priors. A scene decoder predicts pixel Gaussians, filters people/low-confidence points and voxel-merges static geometry. A separate human decoder anchors canonical Gaussians to SMPL-X vertices, uses per-person appearance memory, and poses them with skinning.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2, NeuMan four-view single-human NVS: GUSH3R PSNR 18.6 dB and LPIPS 0.28 versus optimization-based HSR 20.6 dB and 0.58. These use different inference regimes; GUSH3R is feed-forward.
papers.qualifications_review: Camera, geometry, detection and body-fitting mistakes propagate. Heavy human occlusion complicates identities; faces, hands and clothing details remain imperfect.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Globally align DUSt3R pairwise point maps, compress the cloud with farthest-point sampling and positional cross-attention, and condition DynamiCrafter video diffusion through image and 3D branches. Confidence-weighted per-scene 3DGS optimization fits generated intermediate views.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table I, RealEstate10K Easy Set with two input views and three evaluated novel views: PSNR 28.31 dB versus MVSplat 26.39 dB. This is image quality, not metric geometry accuracy.
papers.qualifications_review: Generated unseen content is a hypothesis. Iterative diffusion and per-scene Gaussian optimization remain; this is not a single feed-forward reconstruction.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Retrieve relevant old/new images, run a frozen 3R backbone, and fit confidence-weighted Sim(3) via Umeyama initialization and IRLS. Validate reference camera rotation/translation/scale before insertion; retry with geometric then register-token pruning, otherwise reject the update. Finally optimize accepted camera poses on SE(3).
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables I-II, six outdoor UAV scenes with Pi3x: 95.39% of 12155 images accepted; common accepted-frame six-scene mean ATE is 18.56 m. Largest input scene contains 5871 images. Coverage and error are separate metrics.
papers.qualifications_review: Some images are deliberately rejected. Bounded network inference does not imply constant total map storage; retrieval/model quality matters and a true real-time backend remains future work.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Retain pretrained VGGT spatial attention and add motion-token temporal attention. Predict future point maps in common coordinates; appearance-fused Gaussian heads predict geometry and short-clip constant velocities. Synthetic geometry warm-up precedes real-driving rendering, depth distillation and scene-flow supervision.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 3, KITTI monocular depth: AbsRel 0.070 versus VGGT 0.082. Waymo point-map evaluation uses three cameras; Waymo rendering trails camera-assisted STORM and GS-LRM.
papers.qualifications_review: Constant-velocity motion is local to short clips. Geometry and rendering gains vary by metric; training uses geometry/motion supervision rather than being entirely unsupervised.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Freeze DUSt3R encoder and fine-tune decoder/point heads for time-specific dynamic geometry. Compare optical and camera-induced flow to identify static pixels. Sliding-window global alignment optimizes camera intrinsics/poses and frame depths with weighted point alignment, smoothness and static-flow consistency.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2, KITTI video depth: AbsRel 0.104 after per-sequence scale-and-shift alignment and 0.106 after scale-only alignment. These are aligned-depth errors rather than metric-scale guarantees.
papers.qualifications_review: Full-video results include optimization. Changing intrinsics may need constraints/tuning; small windows suffer long occlusion and open-field domain shifts remain difficult.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Turn gravity-aligned panoramas into four co-located known-yaw perspective views. Frozen DA3 predicts overlapping blocks; three-view rig consensus proposes isolated-view pose repair accepted only when overlap geometry improves. Sim(3) block alignment, cyclic SALAD retrieval, joint DA3 loop verification and a Sim(3) pose graph form the map.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2, Hilti-Trimble-Oxford thirty trajectories: median ATE RMSE 2.704 m for DA3-Legacy versus 2.312 m for RIGOR, using rigid trajectory alignment without scale correction. Geometry scores separately use evaluation-only similarity registration.
papers.qualifications_review: Assumes gravity alignment and known rig. Repetitive scenes confuse retrieval. Co-located views do not supply metric scale; paired ATE improvement is not uniform across runs.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Modulate fixed-size recurrent state updates using estimated inter-frame translation/rotation and Fourier structural richness. Fine-tune a CUT3R-initialized model with point/confidence, RGB and absolute/relative/acceleration pose losses. Stabilize inference with One Euro translation filtering, quaternion interpolation and bilateral geometry filtering.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Long-video ScanNet/TUM pose and Bonn/7Scenes geometry experiments support stability improvements. Short-sequence and rotation results are mixed rather than uniformly best.
papers.qualifications_review: Limited long-video benchmark diversity. Smoothing trades responsiveness for lower jitter; the persistent model state is fixed size, not the entire accumulated output map.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Use frozen VGGT spatial geometry with trainable in-layer temporal attention. Jointly predict future camera tokens and timestamp-conditioned Gaussian velocities; render predicted future views. Train with geometry warm-up, self-exclusive Gaussian rendering, progressively weighted futures and frozen-VGGT pseudo-supervision.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, Waymo future-only evaluation with two context and two future frames: PSNR 27.81 dB at 0.37 seconds on one A100. Baselines use differing protocols; reproduced baselines are separately identified.
papers.qualifications_review: Faraway fast-approaching objects and entirely unseen content are difficult. Forecast horizon is limited and uncertainty grows with long extrapolation.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Initialize human pose/keypoints and scale-aligned monocular depth, then jointly track camera/body against a fixed holistic Gaussian map. Insert background Gaussians and optimize local scene plus deformable human Gaussians using RGB, static flow, depth, silhouette and keypoint residuals; finish with keyframe global refinement.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, EMDB full system on RTX 4090: whole-image PSNR 23.790 dB, rendering 85 FPS, training/optimization throughput 0.141 FPS. Rendering speed is not end-to-end reconstruction speed.
papers.qualifications_review: Sensitive to initial body/depth/keypoint priors. Noisy Gaussian surfaces cause interpenetration and textureless pixel losses can reach local minima.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Construct supervised pseudo-depth as RPC-ray slant distance between an elevated reference plane and ground-truth DSM surface. Fine-tune DepthAnythingV2 with SiLog; infer per-view depths, fuse with SatDN, RPC-backproject and pool p90 geographic heights into a DSM.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, six held-out DFC2019 scenes: mean MAE 4.59 for zero-shot DA2 versus 2.82 for Sat3R, with 1 min 26 s versus 1 min 05 s reported on A100 40GB. SatDN is more accurate at 1.44 but slower.
papers.qualifications_review: Requires RPC metadata and supervised DSM pairs. Winter scenes are excluded, only six scenes are evaluated, and the 150 m depth range matters. Feed-forward depth is followed by separate fusion.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Encode registered RGB-XYZ-confidence in a trainable reference branch and new RGB in a frozen DUSt3R encoder. One-way reference-to-target decoding predicts target points in the reference frame. Train short noisy autoregressive chains without cross-step gradients; retrieval/MST compression orders multiview registration.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Appendix D/Table 8: the 1678-image Rubble example takes 333.48 s on A100 using a hierarchical variant with 100 VGGT keyframe roots plus Regist3R, rather than vanilla stereo registration alone.
papers.qualifications_review: Shares seed-derived intrinsics and uses PnP for cameras. Drift, heuristic tree selection and confidence decay under unseen regions persist; optional post-optimization is separate.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Frozen VGGT plus trainable heads produce canonical Gaussians with normal guidance. Group spatially co-located observations into voxels; query-time attention normalizes within each voxel and fuses one primitive per occupied cell. Explicit actors use tracking/interpolation and sky is composited separately.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, ORAD-3D: PSNR 23.89 dB versus NoPoSplat 22.41 dB. RELLIS-3D zero-shot SSIM/LPIPS are best among tested methods, but DepthSplat has higher PSNR.
papers.qualifications_review: Uses geometric normal supervision. Explicit actors depend on tracking, and image rendering metrics do not establish exact 4D geometry.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Fine-tune frozen-encoder MASt3R decoders/heads using synthetic dynamic InfoNCE correspondences, static matching, geometry and visibility losses. Match each query directly to every target frame by cosine similarity and read pixel matches or matched point-map coordinates without temporal chaining.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2, EgoPoints first-query protocol: all-point average tracking accuracy 61.3% versus CoTracker3 54.2%, but dynamic-only 31.4% versus 35.8%. Gains are not uniform across datasets/subsets.
papers.qualifications_review: Pairwise matching has no temporal context. Requires synthetic correspondence, visibility and geometry supervision; it does not consistently beat specialized trackers.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Adapt VGGT geometry with human masks and training-only DensePose. A ray-aware transformer fuses PromptHMR human features and scene features through SMPL, scale and register queries. Train geometry, then decoder, then jointly align normalized points and visible SMPL-X bodies with scale/temporal consistency.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2, EMDB-2 global motion on 100-frame segments: W-MPJPE 262.3 mm versus Human3R 267.9 mm. This is not best overall against every optimization or human-only method.
papers.qualifications_review: Synthetic BEDLAM2.0 training leaves a sim-to-real gap; extreme scales and very small people are difficult.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Run frozen MUSt3R on overlapping segments. Shared-frame confidence/depth differences weight point-map alignment; camera-pose alignment adds a second edge. Retrieve distant frames with encoder features, reconstruct loop segments and optimize the small segment graph with Levenberg-Marquardt.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables I-II: RealTUM mean APE 0.052 m and 7Scenes mean ATE 0.067 m, with benchmark trajectories rescaled. Default segments contain 60 frames with 30 overlap.
papers.qualifications_review: Depends on local model quality and loop thresholds. Longer segments cost more memory/compute; flexible Affine/SL4 transforms are not consistently better and metric scale is not guaranteed.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Frozen Align3R predicts endpoint point maps/confidence. Train bidirectional decoders with forward/reversed event voxels, RGB/geometry features and explicit query-time encoding. Coarse-to-fine optimization aligns endpoints, inserts query-time points, then jointly refines camera and geometry.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, DSEC real events at skip 7: HTML AbsRel 0.1048 versus RIFE plus geometry 0.1540; the same-version PDF rounds these to 0.105 and 0.154.
papers.qualifications_review: Offline alignment adds cost and unreliable source geometry propagates. Lighting flicker can create events unrelated to scene motion.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.
papers.source_locator_note: Source precision note: the card follows Table 1 of the arXiv HTML (DSEC, skip=7: 0.1048 versus 0.1540). The same-revision PDF rounds these AbsRel values to 0.105 versus 0.154.

papers.method_review: Joint calibrated multi-view/time lifting adapts MoVieS/VGGT with LoRA. Robot mesh depth anchors source Gaussians, and forward-kinematics displacement conditions a learned residual motion branch. A fixed-weight recurrent renderer-feedback stage uses time-shared center corrections that preserve learned displacement.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, 256 held-out DROID recorded-input clips: novel-view PSNR 16.08 dB and robot EPE 8.6 mm versus MoVieS 13.93 dB and 22.2 mm. Stage 1 takes 0.59 s; four-update pipeline takes 9.08 s.
papers.qualifications_review: Requires calibration, robot geometry and supplied trajectories. Tested on short 17-frame intervals and stereo held-out views; reconstruction is not closed-loop control. Refinement cannot correct Stage 1 displacement.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Frozen Pi3-initialized DINOv2/alternating attention predicts geometry features. Initialize 4096 explicit queries half from predicted points and half uniform anchors; query-image cross-attention plus query self-attention refines centers and spawns 64 Gaussians per query in a common non-metric frame. Train camera/query/Gaussian heads with rendered RGB/depth; optional per-scene refinement is separate.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 6, 32 views at 448 squared on A100 80GB: at most 262K Gaussians and 11.19 GB versus AnySplat 3.85M and 18.42 GB. Rendering quality varies by benchmark and refinement condition.
papers.qualifications_review: Static scenes only; fixed query budgets limit detail/complexity and the frozen image backbone remains large.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Add Global Context Memory after selected VGGT layers. Chunk-wise self-supervised key/value gradients update MLP fast weights; sum and broadcast gradients across chunks to share sequence-wide context. Predict per-chunk geometry, align overlap by Sim(3), and refine retrieval loops with a pose graph.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, single RTX 4090 KITTI 03/04/10: 2.53 FPS and 10.32 peak-memory table units. Camera/geometry metrics use Sim(3) alignment; synthetic VirtualKITTI is in-domain.
papers.qualifications_review: Full-sequence context differs from causal online processing. Abrupt appearance changes and extremely sparse views cause failures. Offline supervised training changes backbone/memory; inference adapts fast weights without 3D labels.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Encode synchronized unposed videos with DA3 and time embeddings. Frozen camera/depth heads set pixel Gaussian centers; Gaussian and bidirectional motion branches predict appearance, image-plane/depth displacement-derived velocities and temporal attributes. Optical-flow pseudo-labels and geometry distillation train dynamic reconstruction.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2, ExoRecon held-out views: feed-forward PSNR 29.15 dB; 100-step post-optimization raises it to 31.95 dB. These are separate inference regimes.
papers.qualifications_review: Assumes synchronized streams and a static camera rig. Teacher errors limit quality and first-order motion does not capture all dynamics.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Jointly train local point maps, cameras and camera-coordinate sparse 3D tracks from a Pi3-initialized backbone. Bidirectional track/map agreement uses controlled stop-gradients; static track anchors constrain cameras. Mix labeled 3D data with pseudo 2D tracks from in-the-wild video.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 4, similarity-aligned ETH3D point maps: mean accuracy distance 0.173 versus Pi3 0.194. Table 2 RealEstate10K pose AUC@30 is 86.60 versus 85.90. TAPVid-3D uses a separate fine-tuned tracking variant plus MegaSaM.
papers.qualifications_review: Not best on every pose/depth/geometry benchmark. 2D consistency alone has scale ambiguity and still needs labeled geometry to stabilize training.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Approximate global attention with pooled coarse attention guiding top-k full-resolution key/value regions. A learned per-query gate combines coarse and fine outputs while retaining all output queries; fused Triton kernels avoid full score materialization. Train sparse students against dense teacher depth/pose predictions.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Figure 4, H100 with 1024 images, Pi3 variant: dense latency 202.39 s versus 16.38 s, about 12.4 times faster. Training is required; sparsity does not prune output queries.
papers.qualifications_review: Short or strict-threshold pose accuracy can trail dense attention. Dual branches incur reported 15% memory overhead and top-k trades speed for accuracy.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Select geometry-aware keyframes, reconstruct CUT3R submaps, and register them using shared frames. A differentiable Gaussian map refines camera poses and depth scale, then jointly updates window geometry/poses. Loop submaps and an SE(3) graph precede offline global bundle adjustment.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables I/III/IV: 7Scenes mean ATE 4.9 cm; ScanNet-v2 ATE 7.41 cm and NVS PSNR 30.47 dB. Rendering metrics have tradeoffs and these results include offline global refinement.
papers.qualifications_review: Indoor benchmarks only. Camera intrinsics initialize Gaussians; optimization is neither entirely feed-forward nor real-time, and planar boundaries can oversmooth.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Learn dynamics masks from VGGT features. Camera/register queries suppress moving-region keys while geometry patch queries retain their information. Fine-tune middle global-attention layers with camera/depth/point-map supervision, freezing the remaining backbone/heads.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, Sintel scale-aligned video depth: AbsRel 0.484 for VGGT versus 0.357 for PAGE-4D. Geometry and camera tasks are evaluated separately; downstream rendering uses another Gaussian model.
papers.qualifications_review: No point-tracking head. Aligned benchmark geometry does not establish absolute metric scale; rendering requires a separate downstream representation.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Extend VGGT with a target-time token and adaptive-LayerNorm decoder. Predict own-time point maps in first-camera coordinates, then warp each source map to a common query timestamp with a shared DPT head. Reuse the backbone and rerun the time-conditioned decoder for new query times.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2, ten-frame dense tracking: normalized EPE 0.032 on PointOdyssey and 0.042 on Waymo versus DPM 0.114 and 0.103. Unit-mean-normalized geometry errors are not metres.
papers.qualifications_review: Feed-forward scope is short snippets; longer videos use window fusion/optimization. Pi3 remains stronger on reported depth/pose benchmarks.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Replace VGGT global attention with block-causal temporal attention and cache past keys/values. Frozen DINO features feed a trained streaming decoder and geometry/camera heads. Full-sequence VGGT teacher pseudo-targets distill the causal student.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, sparse 3-5-view 7Scenes reconstruction: mean completeness distance 0.115 versus CUT3R 0.154 and offline VGGT 0.091. This is a distance metric, not percentage success.
papers.qualifications_review: KV cache grows with history and long streams raise memory/compute. It does not provide constant-memory unlimited streaming.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: DUSt3R-initialized dual decoders reconstruct the previous reference view in a shared first-camera frame and produce the next query. Encode predicted geometry into spatial key/value memory, gate redundant writes, and retain high-attention long-term tokens. Train supervised short sequences with scale/confidence losses.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 and runtime discussion: about 65 FPS and 11 GB on RTX 4090 at 224 squared in online mode. Offline unordered mode first constructs a pair graph and has a different cost.
papers.qualifications_review: Unknown overall scale, no bundle adjustment, drift at reflections/loops, and long forward or multiroom paths can fail. Thin structures suffer low resolution.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Fine-tune two pretrained experts end-to-end: DA3 predicts cameras, then a pose-conditioned Multi-view Pyramid Transformer generates pixel-aligned Gaussians. Rendering plus relative-camera losses preserve appearance and geometry; known cameras can bypass the geometry expert.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, DL3DV twelve inputs at 224 squared: pose-free, no EPA and no view-dependent opacity, PSNR 23.851 dB versus YoNoSplat 20.383 dB. EPA and opacity variants are reported separately.
papers.qualifications_review: Appearance-expert capacity limits rendering; pose accuracy can trail specialists. Larger variants change capacity/data, so they are not controlled comparisons.

papers.method_review: Form reference-source triplets from an unlabeled test scene. Minimize disagreement between the same reference point maps under different source pairs; update only inserted visual prompts in frozen DUSt3R encoder layers. Apply global alignment after adaptation.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, sparse 7Scenes reconstruction: mean accuracy distance 0.105 versus DUSt3R 0.146. Appendix timing separates scene adaptation from the base inference.
papers.qualifications_review: Occlusion, dynamics and illumination shifts remain hard. Only reference maps drive consistency and many-view triplet sampling is costly.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Attach separate geometry/appearance codes to DUSt3R points. Frozen local geometry MLPs regress neighbor SDFs and RBF-interpolate them; trainable appearance MLPs predict radiance. A small synthetic SDF prior guides per-scene code/appearance optimization with rendering, feature consistency and pseudo-SDF losses.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, real DTU three-view protocol: mean Chamfer distance 1.36 mm versus NeuSurf 2.08 mm. Mip-NeRF360 comparisons are qualitative; PSNR/SSIM are not best across methods.
papers.qualifications_review: Requires known camera poses and initial points. Per-scene 100000-iteration fitting is not feed-forward; unseen geometry remains underconstrained.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Predict depth/cameras with MapAnything, voxel-budget and farthest-sample sparse 3D anchors, and aggregate projected RGB/depth/ray features at anchors. Transformer/MLP heads spawn four local Gaussians per anchor; rendering-error features drive a learned forward refiner. Train decoder then frozen-decoder refiner.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, ScanNet++ V2 with 32 inputs and four novel views: full AnchorSplat PSNR 21.48 dB, 247153 Gaussians, 5.52 s versus AnySplat 20.20 dB, 5550940, 6.83 s. LPIPS worsens from 0.32 to 0.38.
papers.qualifications_review: Needs reliable geometric priors. Fixed budgets/constrained offsets cannot easily fill missing structure; evidence concentrates on indoor ScanNet++.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Retrofit frozen Point3R with spherical-address buckets and independent feature slots. Confidence and similarity govern merge/replace/reject writes; prior-frame geometry retrieves nearby buckets plus global anchors under a fixed decoder-readout budget. Optional viewpoint-conditioned pose context is separate.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, 7Scenes 500-frame k=2 point clouds: core accuracy distance 0.0275 versus Point3R 0.0745. Evaluation pre-encodes each sequence although decoder and memory updates are causal.
papers.qualifications_review: Bounded readout is not constant persistent storage; scene coverage grows memory. Hand-set hash/slot/readout choices matter and metric-depth improvements are mixed.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Compress frozen VGGT features plus shared 3D Fourier positions into 128 scene latents and one camera latent. Independent point/normal queries cross-attend to this state; flow matching transports noisy VGGT-centered samples through iterative ODE integration. Optional rendering/depth-order guidance couples points late, then Delaunay extracts a mesh.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Standard evaluation uses sixteen views. Native and dense-view pseudo-ground-truth surface benchmarks are separated. Guidance improves visual coherence but does not uniformly improve CD/F1.
papers.qualifications_review: Depends on VGGT priors and imperfect pseudo-surfaces. Decoding is iterative, guidance is costly, and the learned output is geometry rather than radiance.

papers.method_review: Select descriptor-neighbor assist views greedily for token coverage, reliability and diversity. One gated cross-view interaction preconditions each view before full global aggregation. Occupancy/reliability-sensitive voxel softmax fusion sharpens confident contributors and suppresses redundant Gaussian detail loss.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2, DL3DV 64 views: baseline PSNR 21.14, fusion-only 21.57, assist-plus-fusion 21.67 dB. Table 3 separates the ACID overlap stress test at 48/72 views.
papers.qualifications_review: Full global attention remains. Assist conditioning is disabled for sparse inputs; improvements vary by dataset and metric, so additional views do not guarantee universal gains.
